scope: Recheck1 native UI patch gate screenshots and temporal/focus/layout records only; tester-feedback gate excluded.
result: No persistent fixed-control layout blocker found in settled captures. Immediate Tools resize transients are explicitly observed for fresh and upgraded installations.
method: Each of 43 unique BMP hash representatives across both paths was individually viewed as a lossless original-resolution PNG; the remaining 39 captures were covered by verified identical BMP hashes. Every BMP hash and dimension matches native-ui-patch.json, and every corresponding PNG was verified RGB-pixel-identical to its BMP. Recorded fixed-control bounds and button non-overlap were independently rechecked.
limitations: These finite still frames do not establish zero flicker; immediate Tools resize frames show old geometry before settling.
The nominal 250/750/1250 ms filenames are sampling targets; use recorded elapsed times in each temporal series.

Only 96 DPI and actual 960 by 680 / 1024 by 728 main-window sizes were observed; requested 1280 by 900 was clamped to the hosted work area. No high-DPI transition or multi-monitor validation is claimed.
Partially visible References controls are within scrollable settings content, not fixed footer controls. Long folder paths are clipped inside edit fields.
Focus holds are sampled for about 2.4 seconds; they do not instrument exact queue poll counts or every possible intervening event.
Updater observations cover this exact published 0.16.0 to candidate 0.16.1 path and synthetic fixtures; no broad release/updater acceptance or representative-PC acceptance is inferred.
Scientific, realistic workload, physical trackpad, institutional security and signing checks are outside this review.
evidenceMinimization: Focused receipt retains exact report/capture hashes and layout observations. Runtime window handles, local storage paths and redundant raw observations are omitted. Original BMPs remain in Actions artifacts.
